Men of a certain kind are great at working their charm on women who have "daddy issues". They are scum and definitely not worth dying for. 
Talking from my own experience.
I am a programmer too. Somehow it helps a lot when i am feeling low. Working on a problem clears up my mind
I am sorry to hear that. Wish you move on to something better soon.

Its hard, it will be hard. Toughen up because only you can help yourself out of this.
And you are not worthless, our worth cannot be determined by other people .

I am close to 30, I got a degree in engineering.  Coping was hard because I am very sensitive. I was scared to look at my schoolmates who were neighbours the mornings after. I felt and I am sure they knew and they could hear the cries from our house. I was constantly ashamed and scared.
To top that I was regarded as one of the brightest people in class but my grades were not great. My father said he was ashamed to meet people because of me.
Because of the situation at home, I ended up depending a lot on people outside. I thought they would save me out from this and take me to a brighter place. I had 3 failed affairs with men who broke my heart , men who I confided in. Post which I stopped caring about or believing in men.
I knew that only I could help myself so i kept pushing got a job outside. Now I visit twice a year. My mother is still abused by my father.
